title: Nile University Library — public contact details
text: Nile University Egypt library contact details: Library@nu.edu.eg. Telephone: (+202) 3854-1861 and (+202) 3854-1863. Published hours: Sunday–Thursday, 9 am–7 pm; weekends closed. Address: 26 July El Mehwar Road, El Sheikh Zayed. This is a dated snapshot of the official homepage, not a live availability check.
retrieval_method: Manually reviewed public search-index copy of the official library homepage, indexed approximately two weeks before review. Direct HTTPS collection failed certificate verification; verification was not disabled.
